answer: Require each identity to lock a 180-unit refundable bond for twelve epochs. Each epoch assigns one random task and requires three attestations from peers with no shared recent contacts; copied wording, reused proofs, or synchronized timing freezes the bond for four epochs. The ledger checks signatures, task uniqueness, reviewer independence, and time windows. Each sybil alias locks 180 units and repeats twelve rounds, while orchard traces reveal coordinated behavior; copper receipts make evidence auditable, and trellis links expose collusion.
